name: sevokecode-image-gen
description: Standalone OpenAI Images HTTP wrapper for generation and editing.

scripts.build:bin:macos-arm64: npm run bundle:bin:mac && pkg --compress GZip --targets node22-macos-arm64 --output bin/sevokecode-image-gen-macos-arm64 build/sevokecode-image-gen-mac.cjs
scripts.build:bin:macos-x64: npm run bundle:bin:mac && pkg --compress GZip --targets node22-macos-x64 --output bin/sevokecode-image-gen-macos-x64 build/sevokecode-image-gen-mac.cjs
scripts.build:package:macos-arm64: npm run build:bin:macos-arm64 && node scripts/create-release.mjs --platform macos-arm64 && npm run build:installer:macos-arm64
scripts.build:package:macos-x64: npm run build:bin:macos-x64 && node scripts/create-release.mjs --platform macos-x64 && npm run build:installer:macos-x64
scripts.build:release: npm run build:bin:macos-arm64 && npm run build:bin:macos-x64 && node scripts/create-release.mjs && npm run build:installer:macos-arm64 && npm run build:installer:macos-x64
